translation.title: Ketoprofen Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and reduction of inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, humeral epicondylitis (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after injury.
translation.usage: Depending on your symptoms, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 1 to 4 times a day and rub it in gently so that it is absorbed well.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have photosensitivity (skin reactions triggered by sunlight), if you have experienced an asthma attack caused by aspirin or other anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you are hypersensitive to tiaprofenic acid, fenofibrate, bezafibrate, ciprofibrate or oxybenzone, if you are 6 months pregnant or more, or for children under 15. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Photosensitivity can occur, so avoid ultraviolet light while using this medicine and for 2 weeks after stopping it. Do not use it in the eyes or on mucous membranes, or on athlete's foot or ringworm. Using it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or a rash, can cause temporary irritation and sharp pain, so use it with care. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing over it. If your symptoms do not improve after about one week of use, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Adverse reactions may occur - rarely shock-like symptoms (hypersensitivity-like symptoms such as hives, difficulty breathing or facial swelling) or an asthma attack (dry crackles, wheezing, difficulty breathing), and occasionally contact dermatitis with redness, rash, itching, blisters, sores, irritation or swelling, dry skin and pigmentation, photosensitivity from direct sunlight, or a skin rash spreading over the whole body; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
